card.title: 20th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.flavorText: The 20th Infantry Regiment was a part of the 16th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army during WWII. The division was raised in 1905 during the Russo-Japanese War but didn’t see any combat at that time. However, in 1937, open hostilities began with China, leading the division to participate in various campaigns. In December 1938, it was incorporated into the 11th Army, and it was demobilized in August 1939. The division was later reorganized, sent to Manchukuo in 1940, and played a role in the Philippines campaign. As the war situation worsened, they were ordered to Leyte Island in 1944, where they faced heavy losses, and of the 13,000 men of the division, only a few hundred survivors remained by the end of the war.
